description: I’m Rithvi, the solo founder of EXPLONAUT+, driven by curiosity about exploring another world. Combining my interests in space science, AI, coding and design, I use NASA’s open data to explore how people could plan missions on Mars. EXPLONAUT+ embraces “The Next Frontier” by turning ambitious questions into working prototypes, testing assumptions and making complex decisions easier to understand through tools others can inspect and explore. Every idea begins with a question worth testing.
